slides.headline: Skagen, Denmark. A summer evening on the *beach*.
The painter walks arm in arm with his wife, *Marie*.
Marie looks away, out to the *sea*.
Their arms are linked. They look like the perfect *couple*.
Their dog trots beside them on the *sand*.
Above the sea, the moon rises in the blue *hour*.
Its light makes a silver path on the *water*.
Far out, a sailboat glides past in the *calm*.
Marie was a painter too, but she gave it *up*.
A few years later she left him. Did he *see* it coming?
